skills.name_en: Goodbye Now, a Sorrow in You

4.on_use_text:
[Combat Start] [Reload (Solemn Lament)] (once per turn)
[Combat Start] Gain Shield equal to (the sum of both [Butterfly] on the selected target)% HP (max 20% per turn)

passives.text:
Begin encounters with 10 of each of [The Living & The Departed]
When spending [The Living & The Departed], select randomly between The Living(Potency) and The Departed(Count) for each [The Living & The Departed] value
When inflicting [Butterfly], inflict the same amount of The Living and The Departed as they were consumed. Example below:
- If this unit spent X Living, inflict X Living
- If this unit spent Y Departed, inflict Y Departed
If this unit runs out of [The Living & The Departed] midway through Skill use, cancel all subsequent Coins and [Reload (Solemn Lament)]
When [Reload (Solemn Lament)]ing, or when gaining [The Living & The Departed], gain either The Living or The Departed based on this unit's current SP
- At 0 or higher SP: 30% chance to gain The Living; 70% chance to gain The Departed.
- At less than 0 SP: 70% chance to gain The Living; 30% chance to gain The Departed.
- The probabilities are calculated separately for each ammo spent

Attack End: If this unit killed the target with its Skill, [Reload (Solemn Lament)]
When this unit gains [The Living & The Departed], gain 2 [Haste] next turn (once per turn)
When this unit gains [The Living & The Departed], gain 2 [Haste] next turn (once per turn)
When an ally hits with a Skill, consume 2 [Sinking] on the target to inflict them with 1 [Butterfly] (3 times per turn)
